widgets_values: Wide establishing shot of a bleak, ash-choked valley of black basalt and smoldering ember pits; distant jagged spires fade into stormy haze. Camera starts shoulder-height and slowly dollies in toward a lone, gaunt cave-dweller with huge pale eyes, thin scraggly hair, sallow skin and a wiry, hunched frame. He clutches a battered short sword, skittering over rock with twitchy, possessive movements. At midpoint the camera performs a quick crash zoom to his eyes and blade, then settles to eye level and a subtle orbital arc left as he bares crooked teeth. Foreground ash flakes drift; background spires remain still, faint heat shimmer over the coals. Low-key firelight and volumetric smoke; desaturated palette with ember-orange accents; anamorphic bokeh, shallow depth of field
